registry_name: Warp & Weft AI Master Textile Dataset Registry

taxonomy_categories.A: Physical Density Labels (Gold standard ends/cm and picks/cm ground truth)
taxonomy_categories.B: Yarn-Level Segmentation / Detection (Individual yarn masks, polygons, or bounding boxes)
taxonomy_categories.C: Textile Appearance / Surface Physics (High-resolution multi-view, SVBRDF, or calibrated scanner)
taxonomy_categories.D: Defect / Missing-Yarn Disruption (Industrial anomalies; does NOT provide thread count)
taxonomy_categories.E: Texture / Statistical Microtexture (Multi-illumination, Gabor/GLCM filter benchmarks)
taxonomy_categories.F: Synthetic Simulation (Mathematically exact yarn profiles with known ground truth)
taxonomy_categories.G: Auxiliary Tabular (Industrial loom production parameters and machine specifications)

datasets.official_name: FabricNET: A Dataset for Basic Weaving Fabric Texture Recognition and Mass Prediction
datasets.authors_or_organization: Ali Can Seckin, et al. (MDPI Sustainability, 2023)

datasets.optical_modality: Handheld USB digital optical microscope with ring LED illumination
datasets.access_procedure: Public open access; available locally in data/fabricnet/

datasets.official_name: Client ASTM D3775 Physical Five-Region Ground-Truth Protocol
datasets.authors_or_organization: Warp & Weft AI Industrial Client Partner
datasets.license_and_rights: Proprietary Commercial Reference (Images protected under NDA; JSON schema open)
datasets.required_attribution: Warp & Weft AI Client Ground-Truth Protocol v1.0.0
datasets.optical_modality: Handheld smartphone camera capture under ambient factory diffuse light

labels_provided.measurement_protocol: ASTM D3775 (5 distinct 1 cm measurement locations, arithmetic mean)

datasets.official_name: FiberDefect-CT: 3D Micro-Computed Tomography Benchmark for Fiber and Yarn Structures
datasets.required_attribution: KU Leuven Composite Materials Group, FiberDefect-CT Zenodo benchmark, 2021.
datasets.file_format: TIFF 16-bit voxel stacks (1000 slices, 512x512 px) + raw volumes

labels_provided.geometric_centerlines: 3D spline trajectories of individual yarn cores

datasets.relevance_rating: 4/5 (High-Precision 3D Ground Truth for Physical Yarn Morphology)
datasets.access_procedure: Public Zenodo download; direct HTTP retrieval

datasets.official_name: Warp Weft New Prod (Roboflow Universe: ayushiit)
datasets.file_format: JPG + Pascal VOC XML / COCO JSON / YOLO TXT
datasets.optical_modality: Macro camera captures of plain and twill fabrics

labels_provided.annotation_format: Longitudinal bounding boxes spanning yarn runs

calibration_details.note: Predicts uncalibrated box counts in stretched pixel window. NMS suppresses 31-50% of adjacent parallel yarns.

datasets.relevance_rating: 3/5 (Yarn Detection Bounding Boxes; Requires 1D Directional NMS and Metric Scale)
datasets.access_procedure: Public download via Roboflow API / Universe web export

datasets.official_name: Warp Weft Detection June 2024 (Roboflow Universe: ayushiit)

labels_provided.annotation_format: YOLO bounding boxes on yarn segments

calibration_details.note: Uncalibrated pixel boxes. Lacks spatial scale.

datasets.access_procedure: Public download via Roboflow API / Universe

datasets.optical_modality: Monochrome macro photography with physical millimeter ruler visible in frame

labels_provided.annotation_format: Fine polygons on surface yarn floats and bounding box on physical ruler scale

calibration_details.method: In-frame physical ruler segmentation ('measure' class) provides dynamic px/cm scale
calibration_details.note: Low mIoU reflects boundary fuzz. Float masks require graph tracking to reconstruct continuous yarns.

datasets.relevance_rating: 4/5 (Float Polygon Segmentation & Metric Ruler Scale Class)
datasets.access_procedure: Public download via Roboflow API / Universe

datasets.official_name: CDATP: Comprehensive Dataset of Apparel Textile Physics and Microstructure
datasets.required_attribution: Li, C., et al. Comprehensive Dataset of Apparel Textile Physics. ACM Trans. Graph. 41, 4 (SIGGRAPH 2022).
datasets.file_format: PNG (16-bit diffuse, normal, specular, roughness, height maps)
datasets.optical_modality: Calibrated photometric stereo dome with 16 synchronized LED flash orientations

labels_provided.surface_normal_maps: 3D surface vector orientations isolating yarn crowns
labels_provided.mechanical_properties: Tensile modulus, bending stiffness, shear stiffness, areal density

datasets.access_procedure: Public academic download (72.9 GB full download; sample subset recommended)

datasets.required_attribution: Harvard Vision Lab Textile Microtexture Database, 2018.
datasets.optical_modality: Multi-illumination photometric reflectometry (16 azimuthal lighting angles)

labels_provided.statistical_descriptors: 40+ GLCM, Gabor, and Markov Random Field parameters

datasets.access_procedure: Public download via Harvard SEAS portal

datasets.required_attribution: Shakir, S., Ten Fabrics Dataset (TFD), Kaggle, 2020.
datasets.optical_modality: Calibrated 300 DPI flatbed color scanner crops (10% spatial overlap)

datasets.required_attribution: Warp & Weft AI Physics Simulation Framework
datasets.file_format: PNG (8-bit grayscale) + exact ground truth JSON
datasets.optical_modality: Mathematical physical waveform simulation (sinusoidal crowns, inter-yarn shadows, Gaussian PSF blur sigma=1.2, sensor noise sigma=0.08)

datasets.official_name: RAW-FABRID: A Benchmark Dataset for Real-World Fabric Defect Detection
datasets.optical_modality: Industrial web scan and raw camera frames of woven fabrics

calibration_details.note: Industrial defect masks only. Does NOT provide yarn pitch or density ground truth.

datasets.relevance_rating: 3/5 (Defect / Missing-Yarn Benchmark; DO NOT CONFLATE WITH THREAD COUNT)

datasets.official_name: AFID: A Public Fabric Image Database for Defect Detection
datasets.authors_or_organization: J. Silvestre-Blanes, et al. (AUTEX Research Journal, 2019)
datasets.required_attribution: Silvestre-Blanes, J., et al. AFID: A Public Fabric Image Database for Defect Detection. AUTEX Res. J. 2019.

datasets.optical_modality: High-speed industrial web-scan inspection line with line-scan sensors

calibration_details.note: Coarse web scan (< 1 px per yarn). Resolution is insufficient for thread counting.

datasets.relevance_rating: 2/5 (Line-Scan Macro Web Inspection Benchmark; Available Locally)

datasets.official_name: FabriD: A Benchmark Dataset for Industrial Fabric Defect Detection

calibration_details.note: Defect localization only. Lacks thread count ground truth.

datasets.official_name: TSFabrics: Large-Scale Industrial Textile Surface Inspection Dataset
datasets.required_attribution: Tsinghua Textile AI Lab, TSFabrics Video Benchmark, 2023.
datasets.optical_modality: High-speed line-scan and area-scan camera feeds over industrial looms

calibration_details.note: Time-series loom video frames. High compute/storage requirement. Lacks thread density labels.
